parts.instructions: You are a new member of the club. Fill in the form. Write in sentences. Use 20-30 words.
parts.prompt:
Do you like Science? Why?
I do like science/I do enjoy learning science/ I am interested in scientific knowledge.
Because science helps me understand more about the surrounding world. Plus, I also had fun with scientific experiments in the lab.

parts.instructions: You are communicating with other members of the club in the chat room. Reply to their questions. Write in sentences. Use 30-40 words per answer.

chatMessages.messageText: Hi! I've been a member of the science club for about 2 years. My science teacher is very enthusiastic.How do you study science at your school?

Nice to meet you! I’m glad that we have the same interest/ hobby. When I was at high school, my science teachers were very passionate, making the classes engaging and enjoyable. Thanks to their support, I have developed a strong interest in this subject. (44 words)
There are two methods to acquire knowledge about science: watching TV programs about science and reading science books. Which method do you prefer?

parts.instructions: You are a member of the club. Read the notice from the club president/manager and write the requested emails.
parts.managerNotice:
Tổ chức triển lãm khoa học tại tòa nhà thị chính địa phương.
I am writing to inform you that the science club is preparing to organize the science exhibition at the local town hall next month. Both young people and elderly people can take part in our activities in the exhibition.
We are planning for our exhibition. Could you contribute some ideas for our event team? What should we display at that exhibition? Whether our club issues free tickets for participants? I would like to hear your contribution.
The manager.

tasks.prompt: Write an email to your friend who is also a member of Science club. Express your thoughts and feelings about the announcement and suggest what you both should do.
Write an email to the president/manager of Science club. Give your detailed feedback, propose constructive solutions for the initiative, and explain why your suggestions would benefit the club.
